title.zh: 在马尼拉大都会达义Bagumbayan描笼涯设立国立中学，名称为Bagumbayan国立中学，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Bagumbayan in Taguig, Metro Manila to Be Known as the Bagumbayan National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Bagumbayan in Taguig, Metro Manila to Be Known as the Bagumbayan National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2000/ra_8845_2000.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established a national high school in Barangay Bagumbayan in Taguig, Metro Manila to be known as the Bagumbayan National High School under the Department of Education, Culture and Sports.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, August 22, 2000.
